d: The Pistons defeated the Pelicans, 122-109 tonight in New Orleans. John Collins contributed a team-high 20 points to go with 7 rebounds 4 three pointers and 2 assists, with Javonte Green of the Pistons adding an additional 18 points (7-12 FG, 3-7 3P) in the game. Zion Williamson finished with a team-high 24 points along with 7 rebounds for the Pelicans in the losing effort. The Pistons improve their record to 10-4 with the win, while the Pelicans fall to 5-11 for the season.
